metadata.description: Lintsure for Claude Code: security and compliance checks on the code your agent writes, with a workspace that tracks findings, decisions and verified fixes.

plugins.name: lintsure
plugins.description: Checks the code your agent writes against GDPR, the EU AI Act, OWASP Top 10, OWASP LLM Top 10, CWE Top 25 and the CRA. Scans run on your machine; only findings reach your workspace.
